translation: In Bhilapur, at the home of Bhagvandas-Dhanbai, Jivanji Maharaj lay down to rest on Magsar Sud 2 of Samvat 1737. There he had a dream (svapnantar) in which two messengers (duta) came to summon him; Jivanji Maharaj asked them for a delay of six months. At the spot where Jivanji Maharaj had lain to rest, there stood a dense thicket of trees. Today, at that site...
